package.description: A free forensic utility for converting data found on desktop and mobile devices into human-readable timestamps.

en-US.description: A free forensic utility for converting data found on desktop and mobile devices into human-readable timestamps.
en-US.longDescription: DCode is a free forensic utility that converts timestamp data found on desktop and mobile devices into human-readable timestamps. It supports 69 different timestamp formats from various operating systems and platforms, including Little-Endian and Big-Endian hexadecimal, 64-bit and 32-bit integers, double-precision floating-point numbers, and text formats. It also supports time zone translation, showing UTC (Zulu) times and converted local times based on the selected time zone, and can encode timestamps into a number of different formats and data types.
en-US.name: DCode

zh-CN.description: 一款免费的取证实用工具，可将桌面和移动设备上发现的数据转换为人类可读的时间戳。
zh-CN.longDescription: DCode 是一款免费的取证实用工具，可将桌面和移动设备上发现的时间戳数据转换为人类可读的时间戳。它支持来自各种操作系统和平台的 69 种不同的时间戳格式，包括小端和大端十六进制、64 位和 32 位整数、双精度浮点数以及文本格式。它还支持时区转换，可显示 UTC（Zulu）时间以及基于所选时区转换后的本地时间，并可将时间戳编码为多种不同的格式和数据类型。
